title: Blinking Eyes Behaviors and Face Temperatures of Students in YouTube Lessons-For the Future E-learning Class
reason: Eight students watched YouTube maths videos while eye blinks and facial temperature were recorded by camera/thermography; patterns are described against questionnaire impressions without statistics. Biometric sensors are not LMS-measurable indicators.

extraction.n_quote: Eight students were chosen as examinee totally.
extraction.population: students aged 18-20 at two National Institute of Technology colleges (Gifu, Suzuka)
extraction.lms_indicators: none (blink counts and facial temperature from external sensors)
extraction.outcome_or_construct: self-reported impressions/confusion; correctness of answers (all correct)
extraction.notes: Secondary E1: no statistical analysis; correlation claimed only by inspection of plots.
